collection.title: Skoda Octavia Hatchback 2004 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Octavia Hatchback Mk2 2004 to 2012 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Octavia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
